## 8d83f9744f6a

**Classification: reproduced defect.** I checked all four canonical input pairs and 60 ordinary generated draws (20 per difficulty band) against generator version `1.2.0`, SHA-256 `fa69f800a10514f9ed80d3e708ef3c2ae06b49b82fa4ec46eeac367635cfae95`.

The generator and `self_check` hard-code foreground color 3. Only canonical pair 0 uses palette `{0,3}`; pairs 1–3 use `{0,5}`, `{0,7}`, and `{0,4}`, and `self_check` rejects all three. Thus canonical support is 1/4 even though color is not part of the transformation. All 60 sampled generator draws used exactly palette `{0,3}`, so the ordinary distribution never repairs the missing palette support. The generator also has no pinned `RULE_HASH`.

Evidence: `checks/audit/8d83f9744f6a/canonical_palette_report.json`. I did not modify this audit target.
